commit.message: test: complete open-issue verification and hardening
feat: resolve open compatibility and hardening issues
chore: merge main into issue branch
ci(coverage): make cached install idempotent

ci: preserve Cargo install metadata

Coverage tool caches must keep Cargo's package tracking files with the binaries. Version the cache layout so existing incomplete caches cannot break installation.

ci: enforce test coverage ratchet

Start from the measured 76.917518% baseline and ratchet toward the 80% target without blocking all changes during the ramp.

Closes #150

fix(ci): require public GHCR package

Authenticated manifest checks can pass for private packages. Probe GHCR without credentials and fail closed before completing a release.

Refs #144

fix(ci): scope release guard to the version being published

An orphan tag left by an earlier run failed check-github-releases.rs after
the new release had already been created, so the release run published a
release and then skipped every Docker job (issue #128).

- scope the post-release guard to --release-version, hard-failing only when
  the version just published has no release
- report unrelated historical orphans as warnings, and do it before the
  release is created rather than between creation and image build
- name the remediation (create the release or delete the tag) in the message
- keep the scheduled verify-releases workflow failing hard on any drift

Fixes #128

Merge remote-tracking branch 'origin/main' into issue-118-f22842a1cf41

# Conflicts:
#	tests/release_workflow_test.rs

fix(ci): detect missing GitHub releases

Verify release coverage after publication and on a daily schedule so skipped release objects cannot remain silent.\n\nCloses #118

perf(container): remove bundled vendor CLI

Publish one Bun-ready runtime per architecture and fetch compatibility
CLIs only for the login that needs them.

Refs #116

chore(ci): merge native image publishing

Keep the newly merged native ARM64 build path while releasing crates and GitHub notes before the four cached Docker matrix legs.

perf(ci): decouple cached image releases

Publish the crate and GitHub release before fanning out cached Docker image builds.\n\nCloses #112
fix(ci): build arm64 images natively
fix(ci): publish multi-arch images
fix(ci): make release checks fail closed
ci: refresh cached cargo-audit

fix(docker): include embedded admin UI

Build the default runtime image in CI before automatic or manual releases.\n\nCloses #59
docs: write down the issue #52 security review pass and audit CI

feat: publish a with-claude-cli image variant and document container credential lifecycle

Adds the packaging and documentation halves of issue #48, on top of the
router-driven Claude refresh:

- Dockerfile splits into runtime-base -> with-claude-cli, keeping the
  minimal 'runtime' stage last so a plain 'docker build .' is unchanged.
- release.yml publishes both images, tagging the variant ':with-claude-cli'
  and ':<version>-with-claude-cli'.
- README/self-hosting document which operations need a writable
  CLAUDE_CODE_HOME (only first-time login) and give a derived-image recipe.
- refresh.rs gains a refresh_at() seam so the Claude exchange is verified
  against a stub token endpoint instead of console.anthropic.com.
feat: publish Docker Hub releases
fix: harden crates release publishing
ci: publish release container to ghcr
Initial commit
